messages:
Ravi (AE): quick sync - Meridian Bio wants Dedicated + Private for a healthcare pilot. asking for a 40% discount on a 24-month commit and an initial 6-week POC. security questionnaire flagged PHI. can we approve 40% or what are the guardrails?
Ana (Sales Ops): drop rough ARR and expected average monthly tokens so finance can run impact. also need to know if they want prepay.
Ravi (AE): ballpark ARR year1 ~$850k, monthly ~70k at list. client prefers annual prepay if that helps.
Marco (Finance): 40% on that run rate reduces margin too much unless we get stronger commitments (prepay + minimums + termination fees). guideline: up to 30% off with standard 2yr commit; up to 35% with annual prepay + exec approval. anything >35% needs CRO sign-off plus financial justification.
Carmen (Security): we need completed questionnaire before prod. for POC we can sandbox with redacted data, but Private deploy + customer-managed KMS will add ops effort; estimate extra monthly support $9k.
Ivy (SE): POC scope looks standard: model integration + privacy review. we can limit token throughput and provide a POC credit instead of permanent concession. Suggest $30k POC credit, waive onboarding fee.
Ravi (AE): proposed structure: agree to 35% off list for 24 months if Meridian prepays year1; include $30k POC credit and waived onboarding. we also itemize private deploy uplift $9k/mo. Legal to add termination language.
Sam (RevOps): if Meridian prepays, our NRR improves. share detailed numbers here and include POC credit as one-time contra in the contract. we can model at 35%+credit; anything beyond needs CRO.
Marco (Finance): acceptable conditional approval: 35% + $30k credit only if (1) annual prepay year1, (2) quarterly minimums, (3) private uplift passes security review and client signs the KMS annex. Otherwise cap at 30%.
LegalBot (bot): opened ticket LEG-3571 for KMS annex + POC credit terms. ETA draft 2 business days.
Ana (Sales Ops): next steps assigned: Ravi confirm prepay intent; Ivy to scope POC delivery & timeline; Carmen to estimate security review time; Sam to finalize pricing sheet; Marco to prep finance concession memo.
Ravi (AE): reached out to Meridian; they confirmed likely annual prepay but want official pricing to present to procurement. I'll push for prepay confirmation and post update.
Carmen (Security): if Meridian provides completed questionnaire, we can do POC sign-off in 7 business days; otherwise 12-15 days.
Ivy (SE): POC delivery ETA 3 weeks after sandbox access. token caps and redaction requirements needed from Meridian.
Sam (RevOps): provisional authorization: approve up to 35% + $30k POC credit for 24mo commit with annual prepay and security checklist completed. Escalate to CRO for >35%.
Marco (Finance): noted. finance will sign off pending prepay confirmation and legal draft.
Ravi (AE): update - Meridian submitted questionnaire answers; attaching to LEG-3571. they verbally confirmed annual prepay. moving to legal and finance for final. :white_check_mark:
